# MCP Hub — discover and wire up Model Context Protocol servers

Curated by Skill Harbor — @claude-office-skills' mcp-hub skill: a directory-style guide to the MCP (Model Context Protocol) server ecosystem. It explains the architecture (Claude ↔ MCP server ↔ external resource), showcases popular document servers (filesystem, google-drive, puppeteer, sqlite) with a working config example, provides discovery resources (mcp.run, awesome-mcp-servers, mcp-awesome.com), shows how MCP tools surface inside skills, and ships a small pip install for document-processing dependencies. Honest caveats: this is a guide and signpost skill, not tooling — it doesn't add capabilities by itself, it points the agent to external MCP marketplaces and config snippets; the "1200+ tools" headline is aspirational, so treat the count as marketing. MIT licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
